_about: Reinsurance deal bot. Same code as the E&S bot (config.json); run with BOT_CONFIG=config.re.json BOT_STATE_DIR=state-re BOT_LOG_DIR=logs-re.
_stage_field: The Reinsurance pipeline has its own stage SELECT, separate from the shared Stage field.
_include_unassigned: No-pipeline deals belong to the E&S bot.
_watch_segments: Also flag every deal whose company is on these lists (CorgiRe brokers), whatever its pipeline.
_require_submitted_flag: Off: a deal is announced once it has a name and nobody has edited it for new_deal_settle_minutes; no Submitted tick needed.
_appointments: Agency appointments are E&S business; the E&S bot announces them.
